post.text:
A massive rhino gently approaches a small deer, showing the quiet kindness that can exist in nature

 https://t.co/EusxRtdJf7
post.author_description: science in context , art history and technology

description.description: A series of frames showing an encounter between a large rhinoceros and a small deer-like animal (likely a dik-dik or small gazelle) in a snowy enclosure. In the first frame, they observe each other from a distance across the snow. By the second and third frames, the rhino moves closer to the small animal near a fallen log. In the final frame, the rhino is standing directly over the much smaller creature, which remains calm and unmoving as they interact.
